## Summary
Extract biomedical entities from embedded content chunks using NER, resolve them against UMLS Metathesaurus via batch API, create SubConcept and StandardTerm nodes, and link synonyms with SAME_AS edges using createSameAsIfSafe.

## User story
As a platform engineer, I want biomedical entities automatically extracted from lecture content and normalized against UMLS, so that the knowledge graph has accurate, deduplicated SubConcept nodes linked to standard medical terminology.

## Why this matters
Entity extraction is the core of the knowledge graph. Without accurate NER and UMLS resolution, the graph will contain duplicate concepts ("MI" vs "myocardial infarction" vs "heart attack"), broken TEACHES edges, and incomplete coverage. SAME_AS edges without cycle prevention (AP-14) can corrupt graph traversals used by the mastery engine.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] NER extracts biomedical entities from each ContentChunk using Sonnet
- [ ] Claude responses parsed with safeJsonParse (Rule 2)
- [ ] Content sent to Claude uses sanitizeForContext + buildContextBlock (Rule 5)
- [ ] Batch Claude calls use Promise.allSettled (Rule 3)
- [ ] Model constant SONNET_MODEL used (Rule 4) — NER is core generation
- [ ] Extracted entities resolved against UMLS Metathesaurus batch API
- [ ] StandardTerm nodes created with CUI, preferred_name, semantic_type
- [ ] SubConcept nodes created with name, cui (if UMLS-resolved), status:'extracted'
- [ ] SAME_AS edges created via createSameAsIfSafe (AP-14) for synonyms
- [ ] GROUNDED_IN edges: SubConcept → StandardTerm (Rule 10 — LOD verification only)
- [ ] Supabase written FIRST for all entities, Neo4j SECOND (Rule 6)
- [ ] Unresolved entities flagged with status:'unresolved' for faculty review

## Schema changes
```sql
-- subconcepts table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subconcepts (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  cui TEXT, -- UMLS Concept Unique Identifier (nullable — unresolved entities)
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'extracted', -- extracted | verified | unresolved
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL,
  neo4j_synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  neo4j_sync_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- standard_terms table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS standard_terms (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  cui TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  preferred_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  semantic_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UMLS',
  neo4j_synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  neo4j_sync_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- entity_mentions (linking chunks to extracted entities)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entity_mentions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  content_chunk_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES content_chunks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  subconcept_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES subconcepts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mention_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  confidence REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- After adding: pnpm db:types to regenerate database.generated.ts
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// apps/inngest/functions/p1-steps/extract-entities.ts
import { SONNET_MODEL } from '@journey/ai/constants'
import { safeJsonParse } from '@journey/ai/safe-parse'
import { sanitizeForContext, buildContextBlock } from '@journey/ai/sanitize'
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'
import { createSameAsIfSafe } from '@journey/neo4j/same-as'
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'

interface ExtractedEntity {
  name: string
  type: 'condition' | 'drug' | 'anatomy' | 'procedure' | 'gene' | 'organism'
  confidence: number
  mention_text: string
}

export async function extractEntities(
  chunks: ContentChunk[],
  institutionId: string
) {
  const supabase = createServerClient()

  // 1. NER via Sonnet (batch with Promise.allSettled)
  const nerResults = await Promise.allSettled(
    chunks.map(async (chunk) => {
      const sanitized = sanitizeForContext(chunk.text)
      const context = buildContextBlock('lecture_content', sanitized)
      const response = await anthropic.messages.create({
        model: SONNET_MODEL,
        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: context + NER_PROMPT }],
        max_tokens: 2048,
      })
      const { data } = safeJsonParse<{ entities: ExtractedEntity[] }>(
        response.content[0].text
      )
      return { chunkId: chunk.id, entities: data?.entities || [] }
    })
  )

  // 2. Collect unique entities and resolve against UMLS
  // 3. Write to Supabase FIRST (Rule 6)
  // 4. Create Neo4j nodes SECOND (Rule 6)
  // 5. Create SAME_AS edges for synonyms (AP-14)
  for (const synonym of synonymPairs) {
    await createSameAsIfSafe(
      institutionId,
      synonym.sourceId,
      synonym.targetId,
      { created_by: 'pipeline' }
    )
  }
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-02: JSON.parse on NER response
const entities = JSON.parse(response.content[0].text)

// ✗ AP-05: Unsanitized chunk text in prompt

// ✗ AP-14: Direct SAME_AS creation without cycle check
await neo4jQuery(id, 'MERGE (a)-[:SAME_AS]->(b)', ...)  // No cycle check!

// ✗ Rule 10: GROUNDED_IN on wrong node type
await neo4jQuery(id, 'MERGE (ai:AssessmentItem)-[:GROUNDED_IN]->(st:StandardTerm)')  // WRONG

// ✗ AP-04: Hardcoded model
model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514'
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E03/E03-S07.pipeline.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'

test.describe('E03-S07: Entity extraction (NER + UMLS + SAME_AS)', () => {
  test('SubConcept nodes created from lecture chunks', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/subconcepts`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      expect(data.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
      for (const sc of data) {
        expect(sc.name).toBeTruthy()
        expect(['extracted', 'verified', 'unresolved']).toContain(sc.status)
      }
    }
  })

  test('UMLS-resolved entities have CUI and StandardTerm', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/subconcepts`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      const resolved = data.filter((sc: any) => sc.cui)
      // At least some entities should resolve against UMLS
      if (resolved.length > 0) {
        for (const sc of resolved) {
          expect(sc.cui).toMatch(/^C\d{7}$/) // UMLS CUI format
        }
      }
    }
  })

  test('SAME_AS edges created via createSameAsIfSafe', async ({ request }) => {
    // Verify SAME_AS edges exist and were created safely (no cycles)
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/same-as-edges`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      for (const edge of data) {
        expect(edge.created_by).toBe('pipeline')
        expect(edge.safe).toBe(true)
      }
    }
  })

  test('GROUNDED_IN edges only on SubConcept → StandardTerm', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/grounded-in-edges`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      for (const edge of data) {
        expect(edge.from_type).toBe('SubConcept')
        expect(edge.to_type).toBe('StandardTerm')
      }
    }
  })

  test('Negative: unresolved entities flagged correctly', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/subconcepts?status=unresolved`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      for (const sc of data) {
        expect(sc.status).toBe('unresolved')
        expect(sc.cui).toBeNull()
      }
    }
  })
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS entity_mentions; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS subconcepts; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS standard_terms;`
2. Neo4j: `MATCH (sc:SubConcept) WHERE sc.status = 'extracted' DETACH DELETE sc`
3. Neo4j: `MATCH (st:StandardTerm) WHERE st.source = 'pipeline' DETACH DELETE st`
4. `git stash && git checkout develop`
